evidence.title: RFK Jr.'s embrace of AI confounds some MAHA allies and medical experts

occurrences.checkable_against: Clinical AI adoption research and Dr. Robert Wachter's statement
occurrences.quote_span: But AI adoption is likely to further bolster the recommendations of medical professionals, rather than the contrarian views often favored by Kennedy, according to Wachter.
occurrences.speaker: Dr. Robert Wachter
occurrences.subject: MAHA Summit

occurrences.checkable_against: Moms Across America organizational records and Kennedy campaign employment records
occurrences.quote_span: The group was founded by Zen Honeycutt, a former staffer for Kennedy’s presidential campaign.

occurrences.checkable_against: HHS policy documents and healthcare productivity data
occurrences.quote_span: The technology will help doctors work faster, giving them “more time to treat and care for patients,” she added.
occurrences.speaker: Emily Hilliard
occurrences.subject: MAHA Summit

occurrences.checkable_against: HHS statement or Kennedy administration policy materials
occurrences.quote_span: Kennedy wants to give Americans more control of their own health data by using AI “to help them understand it, interrogate it, compare it with the evidence, and make better decisions with their doctors,” Hilliard said.
occurrences.speaker: Emily Hilliard
occurrences.subject: MAHA Summit

occurrences.checkable_against: Dr. Robert Wachter's statement or interview
occurrences.quote_span: Kennedy is correct when he says AI will empower patients with more insights about their health, says Dr. Robert Wachter, a medical technology expert at University of California, San Francisco.
occurrences.speaker: Dr. Robert Wachter
occurrences.subject: MAHA Summit

occurrences.checkable_against: Tony Lyons statement or MAHA Center records
occurrences.quote_span: “The truth is we’re trying to build the biggest movement we can possibly build to actually get things done,” Lyons said.
occurrences.speaker: Tony Lyons
occurrences.subject: MAHA Summit

occurrences.checkable_against: MAHA Summit sponsorship contracts, payment records and panel rosters
occurrences.quote_span: Sponsors paid up to $300,000 and many received speaking slots on panels that included some of the administration’s top health officials, including Dr. Mehmet Oz of the Centers for Medicare and Medicaid Services.
occurrences.speaker: outlet's own
occurrences.subject: MAHA Summit

occurrences.checkable_against: MAHA Summit organizing records and MAHA Center Inc. corporate records
occurrences.quote_span: The summit was organized by MAHA Center Inc., one of a number of nongovernment groups run by Kennedy associates that are dedicated to promoting his agenda.
occurrences.speaker: outlet's own
occurrences.subject: MAHA Summit

occurrences.checkable_against: Kennedy administration policy agenda and actions on artificial colors and undeclared chemical additives
occurrences.quote_span: Cohen notes that much of RFK’s agenda over the past year has focused on trying to curb food industry practices he views as harmful to consumers, including the use of artificial colors and undeclared chemical additives.
occurrences.speaker: outlet's own
occurrences.subject: MAHA Summit

occurrences.checkable_against: Dr. Robert Wachter's public statement or interview
occurrences.quote_span: “Democratization is good,” Wachter said. “But that means disseminating the best science we have, which generally means science created by people who know what they’re talking about.”
occurrences.speaker: Dr. Robert Wachter
occurrences.subject: MAHA Summit

occurrences.checkable_against: MAHA Summit transcript or video of Kennedy's remarks
occurrences.quote_span: At a MAHA summit featuring AI and Silicon Valley executives, Kennedy declared that the technology would free Americans from “medical tyranny” by allowing them to “fact check their own medical advice.”
occurrences.speaker: Robert F. Kennedy Jr.
occurrences.subject: MAHA Summit

occurrences.checkable_against: HHS statement or transcript
occurrences.quote_span: HHS spokesperson Emily Hilliard said Emanuel was describing “one narrow use” of the technology.

occurrences.subject: MAHA Summit

occurrences.checkable_against: MAHA Summit participant and panel rosters

occurrences.checkable_against: Moms Across America campaign materials and organizational records

occurrences.checkable_against: MAHA Summit program and Robert F. Kennedy Jr. public remarks

occurrences.checkable_against: MAHA Institute and MAHA PAC organizational records

occurrences.checkable_against: MAHA Summit sponsorship records and Robert Malone's federal panel appointment
